items.claim: Keep the no-stack test on an error without a stack. `creates new stack if original error has no stack` now passes `new Error('original')`, which has a stack, so `GraphQLError` takes the `originalError.stack` branch instead of the no-stack case.
items.consequence: The falsy-`originalError.stack` case has no test; for example, changing the condition at `GraphQLError.js:195` to `if (originalError)` would leave the suite green (the test at head duplicates `uses the stack of an original error`).
items.proposed_fix: In `src/error/__tests__/GraphQLError-test.js`, keep an original without a stack, e.g. `const original: any = { message: 'original' };` (the `: any` pattern the PR uses in `locatedError-test.js`).

items.claim: The declared constructor now accepts `null` nodes, but the implementation signature `nodes?: $ReadOnlyArray<ASTNode> | ASTNode | void` still omits `null`.
